newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Telrad in 4-year supply deal with Bezeq.
newsitem.headline: Telrad in 4-year supply deal with Bezeq.

text.p: Koor Industries said its wholly owned subsidiary Telrad has signed an agreement in principle for the supply of digital switchboards to Bezeq Israel Telecom from 1997-2000.
The two companies had an agreement that ran until 1997.
Details of the agreement have yet to be finalised.
But a Telrad spokeswoman said the two companies are discussing granting Bezeq a 27 percent discount on the Telrad equipment.
Currently, Bezeq buys about 400 million shekels worth of equipment a year from Telrad. Bezeq's other supplier of switchboards is Tadiran Ltd, another Koor subsidiary.
The agreement is subject to approval from the directors of Telrad and Bezeq, the state-controlled phone monopoly.
